prose: CNBC reports that Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks fell on Thursday after the market learned more about OpenAI's revenue. OpenAI told investors it reached about $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, lower than the $68 billion figure widely reported late last month.
A source says the $68 billion figure included gross revenue from OpenAI's partners, which allows a more direct comparison with Anthropic. The Financial Times first reported the $50 billion figure.
highlights: AI stocks fell on OpenAI revenue details
About $50B annualized at end of September, per investors
FT reported the lower figure first
